<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\n\nClaims handlers cannot process reserve adjustments when the primary approver is unavailable, because there is no backup approver or delegation mechanism. Reserve changes that exceed a handler's authority enter an approval waiting list and stay there until the approver returns, stalling claims indefinitely [i:655489deaf46b80c] [i:fe5045f877fd2a57].\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance reports claims held up because the approver is out and there is no backup, with the approval waiting list piling up [i:17d1c301c6216534].\n- Wexmoor Motor reports claims stuck because reserve changes need approval and no one is covering for the approver [i:4da72a0298cc1806].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting reports that reserve adjustments above the team's limit sit until the approver comes back, with no backup and no delegation [i:62370a71c63f0356].\n- Ravensgill Insurance reports that reserve adjustments beyond a handler's limit go into an approval waiting list and nothing moves if the approver is out [i:655489deaf46b80c].\n- Harrowfield Fleet Mutual reports that when a reserve exceeds authority and the approver is out with no delegate, it piles up and claims stall until someone returns [i:981bdf2d38caaa15].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual reports reserve changes waiting for an approver who is on leave with no delegate set up [i:a220bdb07381e46e].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty reports claims held up because a reserve change exceeding authority sits in an approver's queue with no delegate, creating a backlog on the approval waiting list [i:b8ec7149061609d4].\n- Sallowmere Motor asked for a review of the roles assigned to its claims handlers because some tasks are getting stuck in the queue [i:293889b99ef6cf16].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Across 8 accounts there are 18 mentions of this problem, arriving via 3 routes: support with 7 mentions, sales with 6 mentions, and account management with 5 mentions [i:17d1c301c6216534] [i:47e4aac56f39b4d3] [i:981bdf2d38caaa15].\n- Total ARR across the affected accounts is £5,420,000, with 0 renewals in the next 90 days [i:17d1c301c6216534].\n- Callowfield Auto Assurance (ARR £1,250,000, renewal 2027-03-31) raised 4 mentions, including that a reserve change beyond a handler's approval just sits there [i:47e4aac56f39b4d3] [i:bf46c987929be2c9].\n- Wexmoor Motor (ARR £1,950,000, renewal 2027-06-30) raised 3 mentions, including that the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns [i:b4704c93f5c948f7].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty (ARR £740,000, renewal 2027-05-15) raised 3 mentions, including that reserve updates beyond handler limits are stuck waiting for sign-off with no backup approver, halting payments and reporting [i:d25753b53cd1ed5f].\n- Holloway Reach Underwriting (ARR £320,000, renewal 2027-08-22) raised 2 mentions, including that the approval waiting list is the big blocker [i:eef547df758f4ba9].\n- Ravensgill Insurance (ARR £470,000, renewal 2027-04-30) raised 2 mentions, including that nothing moves until the approver returns [i:96e26adc2310c91f].\n- Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR £690,000, renewal 2027-02-28) raised 2 mentions, including that the approval waiting list just sits there if the approver is out [i:c982d8e917d59cce].\n- Sallowmere Motor and Harrowfield Fleet Mutual each raised 1 mention; no ARR or renewal date is recorded for either account [i:293889b99ef6cf16] [i:981bdf2d38caaa15].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty also reports no delegate at all, causing delays on reserve updates that need sign-off before payments can be processed [i:b9562428ce218966].\n\n## Why now\n\n- The problem is reported across all 3 routes, with support (7 mentions) and sales (6 mentions) carrying the most volume, indicating it is surfacing both in live claim handling and in commercial conversations [i:17d1c301c6216534] [i:47e4aac56f39b4d3] [i:981bdf2d38caaa15].\n- The most recent mentions are dated 2026-10-28, from Callowfield Auto Assurance and Ravensgill Insurance, so the issue is active as of the fact sheet date of 2026-10-01 [i:17d1c301c6216534] [i:655489deaf46b80c].\n- With 0 renewals in the next 90 days, the affected ARR of £5,420,000 is not under immediate renewal pressure, but the accounts involved include Callowfield Auto Assurance at £1,250,000 and Wexmoor Motor at £1,950,000 [i:17d1c301c6216534] [i:4da72a0298cc1806].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty links the delay to halting payments and reporting, extending the impact beyond the approval queue itself [i:d25753b53cd1ed5f].\n",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the aggregate figures (8 accounts, 18 mentions, routes 7/6/5, ARR £5,420,000, 0 renewals in 90 days) against the fact sheet and they all match. I verified each account's ARR, renewal date, and mention count in the Evidence section against the fact sheet, including the null ARR/renewal entries for Sallowmere Motor and Harrowfield Fleet Mutual, and found no discrepancies. I checked the per-account paraphrases against the cited insight quotes (e.g., Callowfield [i:17d1c301c6216534], Ravensgill [i:655489deaf46b80c], Saltmarsh [i:d25753b53cd1ed5f]) and each is a faithful paraphrase with no wording placed in quotation marks. The 'Why now' claims about the 2026-10-28 most recent mentions and the fact sheet date of 2026-10-01 are supported by the insight dates and fact sheet. The Sallowmere Motor entry is accurately scoped as a roles-review request rather than an explicit backup-approver complaint, and no cited contrary evidence was found.", "verdict": "pass"}
